title: The worker packet carries per-stack first-test recipes for PHP, WordPress and npm sites
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 3; risk: a first test in a WordPress/PHP site is vacuous in spirit or needs a missing runtime.
Outcome: brain/worker packet names, per detected stack, how to add the first real test (php: composer + phpunit/pest smoke on a pure function; wordpress: unit seam without wp-env; static/npm: node:test on build output or a pure module) and how to wire krn.json test.
Proof: one fixture per stack goes from vacuous to a real red-on-mutation test via the recipe commands.

Research 1114g ladder (cheapest first, probe before encoding): php -l on changed files; PHPStan level 0 + szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress with --generate-baseline (no new errors); Playwright smoke (200, no 'Fatal error'/'Warning:' on sitemap URLs); per touched function PHPUnit via wp scaffold plugin-tests. See .krn/runs/market/research-1114g.md section 4.
